scope: Content design shown within the existing full page

prompts.name: Calm reading
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Intent: edit the supplied screenshot for a content-only design concept.
PRIMARY REQUEST: Improve the visual design of the ARTICLE BODY while showing it within the complete existing StackOS page. The user explicitly rejected whole-page redesigns and detached content mockups.
TARGET: 1440 x 1800, same aspect ratio and full page composition as reference. Output exactly one realistic high-fidelity website screenshot, no device/browser frame or concept labels.
HARD INVARIANTS: Copy the upper dark page area faithfully from the reference. All content above the warm-paper boundary at about y572 remains unchanged: StackOS logo, two navigation rows, Download for Mac button, breadcrumbs, AI OPERATIONS kicker, the exact large article title, summary and byline. Keep their type, scale, colors, spacing, positions and wrapping. Keep the warm paper body background #f3f1ea. Do NOT introduce a new hero, title, sidebar navigation, CTA, menu, logo, palette, type family or page shell. Do NOT make the content a detached floating card or separate design board.
ONLY EDIT THE WARM-PAPER ARTICLE BODY BELOW y572. Keep Manrope and existing mono detail type, near-black #090b10 text, cobalt #3153d6 accents. Lime #d9ff63 may appear only as a tiny restrained detail. Improve paragraph rhythm, useful emphasis, heading hierarchy and the evidence table. Body is a real document to read, not a feature grid or dashboard. No gratuitous icons, badges, cards inside cards, shadows, gradients or illustrations. Short line lengths; generous but useful spacing; body prose around18px and table text16px with readable leading. This screenshot is a scrolled-page-length preview that must show a substantial portion of the article body together with the unchanged page context.
CONTENT MUST RETAIN ITS EXACT MEANING AND ALL FOUR EVIDENCE RECORDS. No invented facts, simplified measurements, rankings, success metrics or unsupported claims. No rewriting the article. Render this exact copy in the redesigned body:
Opening paragraph: The query “how to do keyword research for AI search” returned null for search volume, CPC, and paid competition in our corrected July research batch. The research decision began there. The empty fields left the question active, while the team checked whether the query came from a concrete operating problem and whether the available record could support a useful article.
Next paragraph: The July case was kept as a small ledger instead of compressed into a single volume judgment.
Evidence headings: Record | What the July case established | Use in the decision
Row 1 Record: Question origin
Row 1 Established: Public workflow jobs, decisions, handoffs, failure modes, and existing material produced 472 exact-new candidates across 15 clusters after deduplication against a 500-keyword baseline.
Row 1 Decision: The query belonged to a documented problem-first research corpus.
Row 2 Record: Measurement receipt
Row 2 Established: A 472-phrase request hit a phrase-length limit; a corrected 448-phrase request completed after 24 over-limit questions were excluded.
Row 2 Decision: Provider task status and endpoint limits became part of the interpretation.
Row 3 Record: Result snapshots
Row 3 Established: Eight selected US/en snapshots from July 12 each contained an AI Overview; the primary query was outside that sample.
Row 3 Decision: The snapshots described related observations from that date.
Row 4 Record: Evidence and ownership
Row 4 Established: The research ledger preserved the method and the July 25 article corpus was reviewed.
Row 4 Decision: The question could be assessed as a separate reader job with a named evidence record.
Next H2: What the measurement instrument actually returned
Next paragraph: The first request contained all 472 phrases. At least one question exceeded the endpoint’s 10-word limit, so the provider task failed. The corrected request excluded 24 over-limit questions and returned results for 448 phrases. That sequence made the task-level result part of the evidence because it established whether the measurement completed.
Current date anchor October 5, 2026. Preserve visible article publication date July 27, 2026 and dated July case data. No new dates.

BODY TREATMENT: Quiet, precise typesetting. Preserve a centered reading column near800px. Remove the large opening shaded callout; make the opening an ordinary comfortable 20px paragraph with just "null" styled as restrained inline code. Normal18px follow-up paragraph. Make the evidence table slightly wider than prose, around1000px, with a flat paper surface, sharp fine horizontal rules, no outer rounded box/shadow. A compact mono header, 160px record column, broad460px evidence column, remaining decision column. Bold record names, regular body text, top-aligned cells and24px vertical padding. A subtle pale tint on alternate rows is acceptable but keep them very light. Small cobalt section rule before a28px H2 and18px following paragraph. The change should look like careful typographic refinement of the original page, not a new brand.
